Career-Focused Education

It’s time to rethink your approach to education.

CIAT is pioneering a new educational approach, beyond the traditional four-year college experience. We believe in innovation, lifetime learning, and hands-on skills that prepare our students for success, with a sincere commitment to helping every student be the best in their field.

CIAT student pathway: build skills, earn certifications, and launch your career

Your path to a career

More than a degree — a full launch plan.

At CIAT, we set you up for more than a degree. Our students build real skills, earn recognized credentials, and get the hands-on support they need to land the job.

1

Learn by doing

Build job-ready skills through hands-on courses designed around what employers actually want. Every program is built to make sure you can perform from day one in your career.

Explore Courses
2

Stack your credentials

Go beyond your degree by earning industry certifications that get you noticed in a competitive job market. CIAT supports students with unlimited exam retakes*, complimentary test prep software, and live test prep tutoring.

View Certifications
3

Launch your career

Our dedicated career resources team works with you one-on-one to polish your resume, prep for interviews, and connect you with employers who are actively hiring CIAT graduates.

Stackable Programs: Build Your Career Step by Step

Every CIAT program is designed to build on the next, so you can start where it makes sense for you and keep moving forward. Whether you begin with a bootcamp, certificate, associate, or bachelor’s program, each step adds real skills, industry certifications, and credit toward your next milestone.

This flexible, career-focused pathway helps you get hired, advance, and continue growing on your terms.

Bootcamp

1–2 weeks

Certificate

3–11 months

Associate

Under 2 years

Bachelor’s

Under 4 years

CIAT Stands Apart

Industry Certification Support, Built In

CIAT students have the opportunity to earn industry certifications alongside their degree or certificate program, with no exam fees, unlimited attempts on most exams, practice exam software, and complimentary test prep workshops all included in tuition.

Already have the skills and just need to pass the exam? Our accelerated one-week bootcamps are built around getting you certified fast.

Flexible Financing

At CIAT, we’re committed to delivering an affordable return on investment, with financing options designed to meet you where you are. From flexible payment plans and FAFSA eligibility to military benefits and over $5M in scholarships awarded, we make it easier to take the next step without putting your goals on hold.

Your career journey is an investment and we’re here to help you fund it, every step of the way.

California Institute of Applied Technology has shared ownership and management of two distinct institutions. California Institute of Applied Technology located in California, and California Institute of Applied Technology located in New Mexico.

Financial aid is available for those who qualify.
